name: Ardois-Bonnot
summary: A fantastic painter who hung a blasphemous "Dream Landscape" in the Paris spring salon of 1926.
description:
The painter appears in Professor Angell's file of press cuttings, one item among the scattered signs of a single worldwide unease: the salon canvas stands in the same line of the record as the wild rumor and legendry then filling the west of Ireland.

What the Dream Landscape showed, and how it was received, is nowhere set down.

sources.quote: a fantastic painter named Ardois-Bonnot hangs a blasphemous Dream Landscape in the Paris spring salon of 1926
